thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] 00:12 UTC — Elevated 5xx + timeouts on /v1/generate (prod-us-west-2). p95 -> ~800ms, p99 -> ~2.1s. 5xx rate up from 0.7% to 3.2% in last 10m. Pager: sara-oncall. Runbook: https://go/runbooks/timeout-regression

sara-oncall: ack — on it. Looking at dashboards: p95 ~820ms, p99 2.1s, error groups are 502/504 gateway & grpc deadline. Deploy at 00:12 to r2026. Tagging @tom-runtime and @maya-eng. Any CI alerts?

tom-runtime: pulling logs. Seeing a sharp spike of connection resets and grpc: deadline exceeded around 00:13. kvcache eviction spike concurrent with increased inflight requests. Edge -> inference-gw 504s. No obvious OOMs. Suspect conn-pool/keepalive changes in r2026 changed request shaping.

maya-eng: confirm: r2026 included a change to connection pooling and keepalive to improve throughput (`conn_pool.max_inflight: 250 -> 500`, `keepalive_ms: 60000 -> 10000`). That reduces per-connection lifetime. Could overload backend process KV warmup and cause head-of-line stalls.

sara-oncall: if this is right, fastest mitigation is rollback. Can someone confirm rollback readiness? @leo-sre you up to flip?

leo-sre: ready. I'll prepare rollback and traffic cut. No infra scaling required immediately. Confirming this is isolated to inference-api route, no DB changes.

sara-oncall: initiate rollback to r2025-stable. Command to run:
```
./deploy rollback --service inference-api --to r2025-stable --region us-west-2
```
Do a gradual weight shift 100->0 over 2m.

leo-sre: starting rollback now (00:28 UTC). Adjusting weights. Monitoring.

incident-bot: Rollback started by leo-sre at 00:28:12 UTC.

tom-runtime: telemetry: after ~90s of weight shift p99 dropped from 2.1s -> ~140ms, p95 back to ~120-160ms. 5xx rate trending down to baseline. Correlation looks strong.

incident-bot: Rollback complete at 00:31:05 UTC. Service weights now at r2025-stable=100. Continuing to monitor for 15m.

olivia-cs: CS update: two customers opened support tickets reporting intermittent timeouts and failed requests between 00:13-00:20 UTC. No major SLA hits reported in billing. Impact window ~7 minutes, estimated failed request rate ~0.6% of US-WEST traffic. Drafted customer template — will send once postmortem headline ready.

nora-product: will post brief note on status.redwood.ai about degraded responses during the window and link to postmortem once available.

sara-oncall: handing over for follow-up to @maya-eng. Handoff notes: rollback mitigated; suspected root cause: aggressive conn-pool/keepalive change causing backend request storms and kvcache churn. Follow-ups: revert config in repo, add long-lived connection e2e, add KV warmup guard, tighten canary ramp checks. I have 18m before handoff.

maya-eng: ack — I'll own postmortem and action items. Immediate todos I’ll create: 1) revert config PR, 2) add canary traffic ramp gating (block on p95 regressions >200ms), 3) add kvcache warmup and monitoring alert for eviction spikes.

dave-devex: suggested runbook updates: if kvcache_evictions correlate with p99 spikes, auto-rollback can be triggered or canary traffic should be frozen. Also add a check for radical keepalive reductions in canary diffs.

sara-oncall: nice. Once PRs are filed, drop links here. I'll close incident after postmortem created and customers notified. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident status -> mitigated. Metrics stable for 5m after rollback. Incident channel will remain open for follow-up until postmortem published.

maya-eng: created postmortem draft: https://go/postmortems/pm-1785554322 (will assign owners + ETA EOD). Reverting config PR is up as draft.

leo-sre: quick note — during rollback we saw no GPU pool saturations; this was network/conn shaping. Good to know for follow-ups.

olivia-cs: sending customer notes now.

sara-oncall: handing off completely. Good work everyone.
